projects.title: BIU Racing Knowledge Hub
projects.description: The team's operating system shared task boards, an automated procurement flow, a live race-readiness score, and a private board for every member.
projects.overview: One workspace where BIU Racing, Bar-Ilan's Formula Student team, plans its work, orders parts, and tracks how close the car is to competition.
projects.challenge: BIU-Racing started without any information system. As the project was founded, the team needed one shared place to manage its tasks and communication.
projects.solution: A shared dashboard for every team's tasks, a procurement flow that carries each request from submission through sponsor check and approval to order. Notifying people and emailing suppliers automatically,and a private My Board for each member.
projects.outcome: One source of truth for the whole team, purchases that no longer get lost, and a live readiness score calculated from real milestones, tasks, and orders.

projects.title: The Orchard
projects.description: A digital classroom workspace for private English tutors — manage student groups, share lesson files, videos, slides and PDFs, and add interactive learning activities.
projects.overview: The Orchard is a focused digital classroom for private English tutors and their students. Each learning group receives a private, organized space that is simple to revisit between lessons.
projects.challenge: Tutors often distribute resources across chat threads, drives, and presentation tools. Students lose context, while tutors repeat administrative work for every cohort.
projects.solution: I created a cohort-based workspace for lesson files, videos, slides, PDFs, learning activities, and games, with a private link for each student group.
projects.outcome: The platform makes learning material easier to access and gives tutors one calm, reusable home for every class.

projects.title: Course & Track Selection
projects.description: A student-focused decision support system that brings scattered course information into one clear, comparable view.
projects.overview: A lightweight tool that helps students choose an academic track and elective courses with confidence. It centralizes information from multiple sources and makes courses easy to browse, inspect, and compare.
projects.challenge: The information students need is spread across many university pages and documents. Comparing courses means repeatedly searching for details such as track, assessment method, grading structure, prerequisites, and syllabus links.
projects.solution: I built a Python-based application on Streamlit that reads from an updatable tabular data source. A clear course grid and detailed course view surface the relevant criteria in one place, while keeping the underlying content simple to maintain and change.
projects.outcome: The system turns a fragmented research process into a focused decision flow. Students can compare options more efficiently, and administrators can keep the experience current by updating a single structured data file.

projects.title: Jumping Wonder Realm
projects.description: An animated fantasy learning game created during a student hackathon with Base44 — combining narrative quests, educational challenges, rewards, and character progression.
projects.overview: Jumping Wonder Realm turns learning into a fantasy adventure. Players choose a companion, travel between themed realms, answer educational challenges, and unlock rewards as they progress.
projects.challenge: The hackathon challenge was to make learning content feel genuinely interactive rather than simply placing questions inside a game-shaped interface. The experience needed to motivate exploration, support continued play, and keep the learning moment at the center.
projects.solution: I created a narrative led game with animated environments, companion selection, themed learning realms, story based questions, a reward economy, and an inventory system. Every interaction contributes to a clear sense of movement and discovery.
projects.outcome: The result is a playful, highly visual learning experience that combines education with progression mechanics. It demonstrates how AI-native building can rapidly turn an ambitious concept into a polished, interactive product.
